nodes.description: Privileged owner address; initialized to tx.origin in the Hackd constructor, which is attacker-controllable.

Public mapping of token balances; written directly in list and transferFrom.
Public nested allowance mapping; set to uint(-1) for tx.origin/uniPair and for the router in the constructor.
Total token supply constant of 1e30 used to compute the owner allocation in list.
Constant token decimals value (18).
Token name string 'HACKD'.
Token symbol string 'HACKD'.
UniswapV2Router02 instance used for the addLiquidityETH external call in list.
Wrapped BNB address used to derive the liquidity pair in the constructor.
Modifier performing an external low-level call to botProtection and requiring a truthy result before the modified function body runs.
Constructor that sets owner = tx.origin, computes uniPair, and grants unlimited allowances to the router and to tx.origin.
Payable transfer entry point that forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Core transfer routine guarded by the checkBots modifier; mutates allowance and balance mappings and emits Transfer.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] to an arbitrary value without any zero-address or race protection.
Owner-restricted function that delegatecalls an arbitrary user-supplied address with arbitrary calldata.
Internal pure function deriving the Uniswap pair address from hardcoded factory init-code hashes.
Owner-only listing function that overwrites balances, performs addLiquidityETH with value, calls botProtection unchecked, and loops over user-supplied recipient/amount arrays.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and allowance mutations.
Origin address used as the contract owner and as the beneficiary of unlimited allowances.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to build the router deadline in list.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary attacker-supplied bytecode inside the token contract storage context.
Low-level botProtection.call(...) executed inside the checkBots modifier before any state updates in the modified function.
External payable value transfer to uniRouter.addLiquidityETH with a timestamp-based deadline.
Low-level botProtection.call(...) in list whose success return value is never checked.
